hooks.prompt:
When writing to .claude/project/features/ or .claude/project/plans/:
- Auto-increment: Find highest US-XXX in high-level-user-stories.md, use next number
- Stories: us-XXX-short-name.md (lowercase filename)
- Plans: us-XXX-plan.md (lowercase filename)
- Display: US-XXX (uppercase in tables/text)

After creating files in .claude/project/features/ or .claude/project/plans/:
1. Update high-level-user-stories.md table with new entry
2. Update Overview counts
3. Link plan to story if both exist
